Study Session: Update on the Equity Consciousness Committee (carried over to 9.1B)
Spring Expansion of the School District / January Reopening

publicComments.name: Linda Joya
publicComments.summary: Expressed deep frustration that her children at Roy Cloud had only 2.75 hours of in-person instruction four days a week and felt the district had failed students during the pandemic year.

publicComments.name: Maria Stockton
publicComments.summary: Asked whether the adult-to-child distancing would change from 6 to 3 feet, raised concerns about lack of SAM transportation and whether the district planned alternatives, and questioned whether buses were being properly disinfected between groups of students.

publicComments.name: Devin Mulaney
publicComments.summary: Expressed concern that students who chose to return in person might end up in a pod rather than with their own classroom teacher if 6-foot distancing was not reduced to 3 feet, and asked for follow-through on the commitment that returning students would be with their teacher.

publicComments.name: Kathryn Stewart
publicComments.summary: Asked specific questions about the Mandarin Immersion program at Orion regarding whether choosing independent study would allow her child to keep access to the Mandarin technology/apps (Better Immersion, Level Chinese) versus switching to a different teacher and losing that access.
